notes: `לְפָנֶיךָ` is split rather than fused: the ASV spends *in* on the preposition and *sight* on the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 governs.

Flagged large unit [s010, s015] retained: one English *no* carries both the negation and the quantifier `כָל`, which is rule 35's fusion (`כָל־אָדָם לֹא־יִהְיֶה` → *there shall be no man*), headed on the negative and discontinuous under rule 25. The competing reading gives *no* to one morpheme and marks the other unrepresented, but neither morpheme owns a part of the single word.
s006 is the comitative `אֵת` (H854) rendered *with*, not the object marker H853 (rule 16's closing sentence).
